title: Two-sided decision fields: what would promote each strategy and what would retire it
rule: every entry is numeric on both sides; an entry that cannot be made numeric is not published as a strategy

rows.promote_if: a closing price with an official source appears AND the benchmark-relative skill's 90% lower bound stays above +0.0261 over 8 further weeks
rows.retire_if: the week-cluster 90%% upper bound on its Brier skill falls below 0, or 4 consecutive weeks of negative skill, or its inputs fail the drift alarm twice
